title: Bangladesh Demands Apology from India Over Sheikh Hasina's Backing
summary: Tensions have escalated between Bangladesh and India following a statement by a Bangladeshi politician, Nahid Islam, who called for an apology from India over its support for the country's Prime Minister, Sheikh Hasina. The demand comes amid rising tensions between the two nations. The situation has sparked concerns about the potential impact on regional relations.
summary_points: Bangladesh demands an apology from India over its backing of Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina
The demand was made by Nahid Islam, a Bangladeshi politician
Tensions have escalated between Bangladesh and India following the statement
Regional relations are at risk due to the situation
India's support for Sheikh Hasina has been a point of contention
